purpose: Preserve immutable historical requirement provenance while allowing newer owner-approved architecture authority to define the effective current classification used by current consumers.

overrides.requirement: **Single architecture authority** — one approved architecture document controls the implementation.
overrides.rationale: The recovered historical ledger predates the current integrated authority framework. The historical A06 assignment remains immutable provenance, while the current 199-phase authority treats the single-architecture-authority rule as owner/governance authority. This overlay changes current classification only; it does not rewrite historical source data.
